title: 采集 P1 改动前资源基线
outcome: A real 300.225s Electron run produced 59 samples at 5s cadence. CPU/RSS and shed counts are measured; process-spawn and live setInterval counts are not exposed by the current Main contract and remain explicitly unavailable.

acceptance.criterion: 基线报告落盘且绑定当前 HEAD 提交
spawn 次数与轮询次数为实测值，非估算
evidence: No spawn or setInterval count exists in the current Main contract; no estimate was substituted. Real CPU/RSS samples are present.

boundaries: The baseline is a real Electron process, not a synthetic sampler.
Spawn and setInterval counts are unavailable rather than invented.
This baseline does not establish a P1 improvement; an after run is required.
All evidence is agent-driven; no real-human evidence is claimed.
